category_summary:
The momentum around open-weight models sparked widespread industry enthusiasm and policy discussions. **Ethan Mollick** highlighted the open-weights release of **MoonshotAI's Kimi K3**, while **Hardmaru** of **Sakana AI** [reaffirmed support for collective AI infrastructure](/?date=2026-07-28&category=social#item-7f0b5ced3650).

- **Simon Willison** [argued against restricting LLM access](/?date=2026-07-28&category=social#item-0414594c572c), criticizing paternalistic safety arguments that underestimate everyday users.
- **Ethan Mollick** [drew structural comparisons](/?date=2026-07-28&category=social#item-14f0955dc5d6) between AI capabilities and corporate organizations, describing large institutions as existing 'jagged superintelligences.'
- **Bryan Cantrill** organized community discussions on open weights, while **Ethan Mollick** [demonstrated practical creative prompting](/?date=2026-07-28&category=social#item-5fcb5eb1d2e2) using **Fable** to generate interactive games.

items.content:
They are obviously very jagged intelligences. Goldman Sachs is very good at some things and very bad at others.

They are also remarkably hard to talk to, even the CEO is a temporary figure in the lifespan of the organization, and even the founder loses control of the entity they made.
